summary: Across the G60 corpus, reviewers most often praise driving enjoyment, ride comfort, quietness, handling, interior and exterior design, build quality, and overall satisfaction, while the clearest recurring pain points concern screen-heavy climate and control usability, missing physical buttons, awkward door handles and access behaviors, inconsistent hands-free trunk and wireless charging performance, connectivity and software friction, and a smaller set of charging, range, and service-resolution frustrations.

signal_notes.interpretation: GB reviews show a greater concentration of negative-or-mixed feedback than the rest of the country breakdown, and the topic summaries suggest this may align with complaints about controls, usability, and feature friction rather than one single issue.

DK reviews also show a greater concentration of negative-or-mixed feedback than the rest of the country breakdown, which is consistent with the corpus containing several usability, control-layout, and feature-operation complaints that can surface in smaller country slices.

limitations: A large share of the corpus is undetermined, so many fragments are too incomplete, procedural, or context-only to support strong product conclusions.
Topics overlap, so the same review themes can appear in multiple clusters and should not be read as additive counts.
Several clusters mix unrelated subjects or noisy keyword matches, especially service-note, acknowledgment, and procedural topics, which limits thematic precision.
Some topic samples include evidence whose wording is sparse or appears weakly aligned with the assigned sentiment, so those topic-level details should be treated cautiously.
Country signals are exploratory associations only and do not establish cause or broader market-level differences.
